description: This file defines the ProductAvailability entity class, which models the availability details of a product including quantity, date available, region, status, shipping, and associated prices.

classes.name: ProductAvailability
classes.description: Entity class representing product availability with quantity, availability date, region, status, pricing, and shipping details.

methods.name: defaultPrice
methods.description: Returns the default ProductPrice object from the associated prices set, or a new ProductPrice if none is default.

methods.name: getProductDateAvailable
methods.description: Getter for the product's available date, returns a clone of the date object.

methods.name: setProductDateAvailable
methods.description: Setter for the product's available date.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Getter for the entity's primary key.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Setter for the entity's primary key.

methods.name: getPrices
methods.description: Getter for the set of ProductPrice objects.

methods.name: setPrices
methods.description: Setter for the set of ProductPrice objects.
